notes.title: Elul Update
notes.content:
Release Notes
------------------
 Bugfixes:
    - Fixed dramatis personae, which was mostly blank (!!)
    - Fixed some other bugs
    - Got rid of stat inflation entirely, since the "turn off stat inflation" seems to have been a little wonky & unreliable.

UI:
    - Implemented glossary paging on mobile (at least, I think I did: I can't test it.)

Identity & Romance:
    - You can reveal trans/intersex identity to suitor during shiddukh, eliciting various reactions. (You can also fill Rivka in that you did this, in chapter 6.)
    - more depth in general, in the conversation with suitor during the shidddukh
    - There are more ways to come out as trans, to various degrees, in the epilogue, and more summary of what that looks like in various romantic and professional configurations
   
Relationships:
    - Improved relationship text (particularly for Moysheh/Basha pining for you after being rejected, and Mamma's reactions in general)
